newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 5.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 5.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government rejected elaborate celebrations for the Day of State on July 6 suggested by the ministry of culture.
- The joint committee of the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) and Lithuania started in Vilnius.
- The foreign loan cimission backed the issue of a state guarantee for $200 million of credits from Western banks for the construction of Butinge oil terminal.
